eras.name: THE MAN
eras.line: Behind every character, still David Jones.

bowieStory.paragraph: Bowie was never just music. Never just the characters he built and discarded. He kept crossing lines — between sound, image, identity — and became something new each time. Our show doesn't retell his biography. It follows that same instinct: through the music, the characters, the reinvention, again and again.
bowieStory.pullQuote: Who am I now? What happens if I become this person? When do I need to leave him behind? And who do I become next?

band.heading: MORE THAN A TRIBUTE.
band.subheading: THE MUSIC. THE MAN. THE STORY.
band.intro:
YADAYADAS is six Israeli musicians who found a common language in David Bowie's music — powerful live rock, built on strong vocals, guitar interplay, solos, and arrangements that hit as hard live as they do on record.

But we're not here to imitate. Through the songs, we trace the man behind them — the characters he built, the worlds he moved through, the constant reinvention that made him impossible to pin down. You won't just hear Bowie's music. You'll leave knowing why it mattered.

final.line1: DAVID BOWIE WAS NEVER JUST ONE PERSON.
